fib: ______ is the management technique that may be useful to caterers to ensure the process the use controlled.

______ can be defined as a system of preparing, cooking and rapidly chilling food within a prescribed time and storing it at low temperature, 0.3OC, prior to its re-generation immediately before consumption.

Cook chill catering can be defined as a system of preparing, cooking and rapidly chilling food within a prescribed time and storing it at low temperature, 0.3OC, prior to its re-generation immediately before consumption.

______ is one of the most common causes of food borne illness and food spoilage.

Risk management is the generic term used to describe the due diligence process of identifying risks associated with day-to-day operational procedures.
